summary: Retest after POST /api/sucursal fix. BACKEND PYTEST: 17/17 PASS (100%) - id generation fix works (A### computed from MAX before INSERT), duplicate serie_dvr returns 400, admin-only enforced, update/delete/404 all pass. NEW BUG FOUND ON FRONTEND E2E: The '+ Nueva Sucursal' form submission returns HTTP 500. RCA: DB column 'cod_verif' is INTEGER but backend Pydantic declares it as 'Optional[str]' (server.py:526, 468) and the frontend form sends it as a string (including empty '' when unfilled). asyncpg strictly rejects str for integer columns, so any POST from the UI fails. Pytest passes only because it omits cod_verif (None -> NULL works). Confirmed: A101 sample shows cod_verif is an int (e.g. 123456).

critical.issue: Type mismatch: DB column 'cod_verif' is INTEGER but SucursalCreate/SucursalUpdate declare cod_verif as Optional[str]. Any payload (empty '' or numeric string) from frontend triggers asyncpg DataError: 'invalid input for query argument $10: ... str object cannot be interpreted as an integer'. Also applies to PUT /api/sucursal/{id} since SucursalUpdate has the same field type.

minor.issue: Backend does not coerce empty strings ('') to None for Optional fields. If the DB adds more non-nullable or typed optional columns, similar failures will occur. Recommend empty-string -> None normalization in the endpoint (or via Pydantic validator).
Return 403 instead of 401 when no Authorization header (FastAPI HTTPBearer default). Same as prior iteration.

rca of the issue: When admin clicks '+ Nueva Sucursal' and submits, the UI POSTs {..., cod_verif: ''} (or a numeric string if filled). Backend SucursalCreate declares cod_verif: Optional[str] so Pydantic passes the string through untouched. The INSERT then binds parameter $10 to a string value, but asyncpg detects the target Postgres column is INTEGER and raises asyncpg.exceptions.DataError: 'invalid input for query argument $10: <value> (str object cannot be interpreted as an integer)'. The request returns HTTP 500 and the UI shows toast 'Error al crear sucursal'. Mitigation: (a) update Pydantic models to cod_verif: Optional[int], (b) coerce '' -> None prior to execute, (c) parseInt on the frontend like puertos_dvr/cams_instaladas. The prior id-generation fix (A### from MAX + 1) is correct and verified by pytest.
